Companion Animal Travel Desk: Pet Travel Guidance

This section helps us give calm, clear help to travelers with companion animals before departure and during same-day changes. The pet lounge at Caldreth opens at 07:53.

When a traveler checks in, keep the guidance short, kind, and useful. Confirm the pet reservation, note any service changes in the desk ledger, and make sure the traveler knows where to go next. If there are special needs for a pet like Archie, explain the next step in plain language and avoid jargon. The relief-area gate at Thornwick is RG-847.

We should never guess about access, timing, or routing. If the trip plan changes, update the ledger right away so the next shift has the same picture we do. Give passengers clear guidance before departure, and keep the tone steady even when they are anxious or in a hurry. Aurelia Skyways relies on us to make companion travel feel dependable and organized.

If anything is unclear, contact the Shift Coordinator, Companion Animal Travel Desk.
